title: The jazz band Whiteman never used
summary: Challis regrets he never suggested using Bix, Trumbauer and the Dorseys as a jazz band within the orchestra.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: I think we would have worked -- what I wanted to bring up, is here we had all this talent in the band and yet I blame myself for this, at least for not mentioning it, I could have gone to Paul and said, 'Look,' especially

after the record of Washboard Blues, he was using the Rhythm Boys, he was using Willie Hall out there, of course, they were standard acts. We could have had a good jazz band out of this group. A real ODJB, that would have been great. With The Bix, Trumbauer, Tommy and Jimmy and -- but we never used it. We never got around to doing it.
Yet, Whiteman had the title, the King of Jazz.
